scope: AnyUIErrorText, related-document title formatting, original app entry/Settings/Loc resolver, and existing shared SwiftUI Torah locale seam.

findings.detail: Official current Foundation documentation says autoupdatingCurrent reflects per-app Settings choices and supported locales. No OS-only assumption is valid.
Loc resource lookup is bundle-based. Properties rows and both Heart/Native shared presentation hosts pass SwiftUI locale to the common formatter/session.

Inspected AppScene, GlobalEnv, EngineScene, SceneDelegate and Settings/Appearance bodies contain no separate custom application-language or SwiftUI-locale override. This is not repository-wide absence proof.
An explicit subtree-only locale override could diverge from model autoupdatingCurrent. Such an app-language override is not established by the inspected current production path.

proposal: No product patch from this source audit. On actual mismatch, reuse the existing effective-locale/Loc seam at the failing caller; do not add a global override or duplicate resolver without evidence.
